MakeCounselingReferralRequest.description: Request to make a housing counseling referral on a foreclosure prevention case.

RecordCounselingOutcomeRequest.description: Request to record the outcome of a counseling referral.

RequestForbearanceRequest.description: Request to submit a mortgage forbearance request to a lender.

RecordForbearanceOutcomeRequest.description: Request to record the outcome of a forbearance request.

ActivateCurePeriodRequest.description: Request to activate an LRA cure period on a foreclosure prevention case.

ResolveForeclosurePreventionCaseRequest.description: Request to resolve a foreclosure prevention case with a final outcome.

TodayResponse.description: What needs attention today, most urgent first, and how many items each area and kind has.

totalCount.description: How many items there are across every area, including those filtered out.

items.description: The items in the requested areas, most urgent first.

areaCounts.description: How many items each area has, every area in work order, including those filtered out.

kindCounts.description: How many items each kind has, including those filtered out.

WorkItemResponse.description: Something that needs a staff member.

area.description: The area it belongs to: applicants, selections, purchases or records.

recordType.description: The kind of record it is about, e.g. application.

label.description: The name staff know the record by.

detail.description: One line saying what is waiting.

dueDate.description: The date it must be done by, if it has one.

waitingSince.description: The date it started waiting, or became due soon; none when the item has no meaningful start.

actions.description: What staff can do to fix it, as keys such as approve-application, in the order to offer them.

urgency.description: "overdue" when past its due date, "soon" when due within a week, otherwise "plain".

WorkCountResponse.description: How many items an area or kind has.

CreateTrustInvitationResponse.description: A new invitation. The token is returned only here; the link is built from it.

token.description: The secret token for the invite link.

CreateTrustInvitationRequest.description: Makes an invite link to the caller's trust.

TrustInvitationListResponse.description: A trust's invitations that can still be used.

items.description: The invitations, newest first.

email.description: The address it was made for.

invitedByName.description: The name of the member who made it, or null when unknown.

TrustInvitationPreviewResponse.description: What the invite page shows before the user joins.

email.description: The address the invitation was made for.

TrustInvitationTokenRequest.description: An invite link's token, sent in the body so it stays out of URLs and request logs.

token.description: The token from the invite link.

AcceptTrustInvitationResponse.description: The trust a user joined with an invite link.

TrustMemberListResponse.description: The users who belong to a trust.

items.description: The members, by name.

name.description: The user's name, or null when the sign-in server gave none.

email.description: The user's email address, or null when the sign-in server gave none.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone id the trust operates in; "today" follows it.

CreateTrustResponse.description: Response from creating a new trust.

CreateTrustRequest.description: Request to create a new trust.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone id the trust operates in, e.g. "America/Denver".

CurrentUserDto.description: DTO representing the authenticated user details.

trustId.description: Trust identifier for the user when membership exists.

hasTrust.description: Indicates whether the user currently belongs to a trust.
